labels.titleRequired: Judul tugas wajib diisi. Contoh: ag + Siapkan presentasi @today p:high +kerja
labels.selectorRequired: Nomor tugas atau kata kunci wajib diisi. Contoh: ag ok 1

labels.shortHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} (ag | agenda | agendamea)

Perintah Terminal & CLI (ag):
  ag                                 undefined
  ag + <title> [@today] [p:high]     undefined
  ag show 1                          undefined
  ag ok 1                            undefined
  ag rm 2                            undefined
  ag find <q>                        undefined
  ag undo                            undefined
  ag stat                            undefined

Server MCP (Integrasi Asisten AI) / undefined:
  ag mcp [list|install|doctor]       Integrasi Klien MCP
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       undefined
  ag hook [set|logs|outbox|test]     Antrean Pengiriman Webhook (Outbox)
  ag ai [status|models|download]     Status Perangkat Keras & Model AI Lokal
  ag doctor                          Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Sistem Agendamea (Doctor)

labels.fullHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} - undefined

TUGAS:
  ag [today|imp|done|/Category]      undefined
  ag + <title> [@today] [p:high]     undefined
  ag show <1|id|keyword>             undefined
  ag edit <1|id|keyword> [fields]    undefined
  ag ok <1|id|keyword>               undefined
  ag rm <1|id|keyword>               undefined
  ag find <keyword>                  undefined
  ag matrix                          undefined

SUBTUGAS / KATEGORI / SAMPAH:
  ag sub <task> [+ | ok | edit | rm] undefined
  ag cat [+ | edit | move | rm]      undefined
  ag trash [-q | delete | empty]     undefined
  ag undo [1|keyword]                undefined

PENGATURAN / SERVER MCP (INTEGRASI ASISTEN AI):
  ag export / ag import / ag sync    undefined
  ag config [key value|--list]       undefined
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       undefined
  ag hook [set|logs|outbox|test]     Antrean Pengiriman Webhook (Outbox)
  ag mcp [list|install|doctor]       Integrasi Klien MCP
  ag doctor                          Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Sistem Agendamea (Doctor)
